items.source: An interface that can be added to any reactive repository so that the repository exposes several methods taking in a Statement from the Cypher-DSL, that allows for full customization of the queries executed in a programmatic way in contrast to provide custom queries declaratively via @Query annotations.

This class registers the Neo4j SpEL Support it is registered by the appropriate
repository factories as a root bean.
items.translation: 该类注册了 Neo4j SpEL 支持，并由相应的仓库工厂将其注册为根 Bean。

items.source: The set of types managed by Neo4j.
items.translation: Neo4j 管理的类型集合。

items.source:
Registered managed types and repositories to be included in AoT (native image)
processing.
items.translation: AoT（原生镜像）处理中需包含的已注册管理类型和存储库。

items.source: An interface for controlling query execution.
items.translation: 用于控制查询执行的接口。

items.source:
A PersistenceExceptionTranslator to get picked up by the Spring exception translation
infrastructure.
items.translation: 一个将被 Spring 异常翻译基础设施拾取的 PersistenceExceptionTranslator。

items.source:
You need to provide an implementation of this interface in case you want to store a
property of an entity as separate properties on a node.
items.translation: 如果您希望将实体的属性作为节点的独立属性进行存储，则需要提供该接口的实现。

items.source:
A dedicated Neo4j point, that is aware of its nature, either being geographic or
cartesian.
items.translation: 一个专用的 Neo4j 点，能够感知其本质是地理坐标还是笛卡尔坐标。

items.source: AoT runtime hints registering various types for reflection.
items.translation: AOT 运行时提示注册了各种类型以支持反射。

items.source: A list of Neo4j simple types: All attributes that can be mapped to a property.
items.translation: Neo4j 简单类型列表：所有可映射为属性的属性。

items.source: This class provides a couple of extensions to the Spring Data Neo4j SpEL support.
items.translation: 该类为 Spring Data Neo4j 的 SpEL 支持提供了一些扩展。

items.source:
A marker interface that indicates a literal replacement in a query instead of a
parameter replacement.
items.translation: 一个标记接口，用于指示在查询中进行字面替换而非参数替换。

items.source: The target of this replacement.
items.translation: 本次替换的目标。

items.source: Internal use only.
items.translation: 仅供内部使用。

items.source: Working on nested relationships happens in a certain algorithmic context.
items.translation: 嵌套关系的操作发生在特定的算法上下文中。

items.source:
This stores all processed nested relations and objects during save of objects so that
the recursive descent can be stopped accordingly.
items.translation: 此功能在保存对象时存储所有已处理的嵌套关系和对象，以便相应地停止递归下降。

items.source: Valid processing states.
items.translation: 有效的处理状态。

items.source: Reactive Supplier for arbitrary relationship ids.
items.translation: 针对任意关系 ID 的反应式供应商。

items.source: Supplier for arbitrary relationship ids.
items.translation: 任意关系 ID 的供应商。

items.source:
The annotation to configure the mapping from a node with a given set of labels to a
class and vice versa.
items.translation: 用于配置从具有给定标签集合的节点到类的映射，以及反向映射的注释。

items.source: Describes how a class is mapped to a node inside the database.
items.translation: 描述类如何映射到数据库中的节点。

items.source: Throw when a query doesn't return a required result.
items.translation: 当查询未返回所需结果时抛出异常。

items.source:
A builder for points, so that coordinates and optionally a coordinate system can be
configured.
items.translation: 一个用于定义点的构建器，以便配置坐标和可选的坐标系。

items.source:
Informs SDN that the method annotated with this should be run once the object is loaded
from the database and fully hydrated.
items.translation: 通知 SDN，应在此注解标记的方法在对象从数据库加载并完全水合后运行。

items.source: Typed preparation of a query that is used to create either an executable query.
items.translation: 用于创建可执行查询的已输入查询准备。

items.source: Step configuring parameters or mapping functions.
items.translation: 配置参数或映射函数。

items.source: Step configuring the query to be used.
items.translation: 配置将使用的查询的步骤。

items.source: The annotation to configure the mapping from a property to an attribute and vice versa.
items.translation: 用于配置属性与属性之间双向映射的注解。

items.source:
Something that makes sense of propertyPaths by having an understanding of projection
classes.
items.translation: 通过理解投影类来赋予 propertyPaths 意义的机制。

items.source: Wrapper class for property paths and information if they point to an entity.
items.translation: 用于属性路径和指向实体的信息的包装类。

items.source: A very loose coupling between a dot path and its (possible) owning type.
items.translation: 点路径与其（可能的）所属类型之间的非常松散的耦合。

items.source:
A strategy for traversing all properties (including association) once, without going in
circles with cyclic mappings.
items.translation: 一种遍历所有属性（包括关联）的策略，且不会因循环映射而陷入死循环。

items.source: Annotation to provide Cypher statements that will be used for executing the method.
items.translation: 注释，用于提供将用于执行该方法的 Cypher 语句。

items.source: Collects the parts of a Cypher query to be handed over to the Cypher generator.
items.translation: 收集要传递给 Cypher 生成器的 Cypher 查询的各个部分。

items.source: Combines the QueryFragments with parameters.
items.translation: 将查询片段与参数组合。

items.source: Trigger find execution by calling one of the terminating methods.
items.translation: 通过调用终止方法之一来触发查找执行。

items.source: Reactive Neo4j client.
items.translation: 响应式 Neo4j 客户端。

items.source: An interface for controlling query execution in a reactive fashion.
items.translation: 一种用于以响应式方式控制查询执行的接口。

items.source: Annotation to configure mappings of relationship.
items.translation: 用于配置关系映射的注解。

items.source: Enumeration of the direction a relationship can take.
items.translation: 枚举关系可采取的方向。

items.source: Description of a relationship.
items.translation: 关系描述。

items.source:
This marker interface is used on classes to mark that they represent additional
relationship properties.
items.translation: 此标记接口用于在类上标记它们表示额外的关系属性。

items.source:
Contains the descriptions of all nodes, their properties and relationships known to
SDN.
items.translation: 包含 SDN 已知的所有节点、其属性及关系的描述。

items.source: A fragment for repositories providing "Query by example" functionality.
items.translation: 为提供“示例查询”功能的仓库提供的片段。

items.source:
A fragment for repositories providing "Query by example" functionality in a reactive
way.
items.translation: 为以响应式方式提供“示例查询”功能的仓库提供一个片段。

items.source: Supporting class for CypherDSL related customizations.
items.translation: 支持 CypherDSL 相关自定义的辅助类。

items.source: Utilities for templates.
items.translation: 模板工具。

items.source: Indicator for an empty collection.
items.translation: 空集合的指示器。

items.source:
Representation of a user agent containing sensible information to identify queries
generated by or executed via Spring Data Neo4j.
items.translation: 包含用于标识通过 Spring Data Neo4j 生成或执行的查询的合理信息的用户代理表示。

items.source:
This is a value object for a Neo4j user, potentially different from the user owning the
physical Neo4j connection.
items.translation: 这是 Neo4j 用户的值对象，可能与拥有物理 Neo4j 连接的用户不同。

items.source: A generator providing UUIDs.
items.translation: 提供 UUID 的生成器。

items.source: Indicates a vector search on a repository.
items.translation: 表示对仓库执行向量搜索。

items.source: Collected params for vector search.
items.translation: 已收集向量搜索的参数。
